test_title: PYST 41 - SSC CHSL 2025 - General Intelligence (Held On: 27 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Ina certain coded language 'CRAPS' is coded as 'PLXNZ' and 'DINED' is coded as 'AAKEA'. How will 'INTRO' be coded in the same code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/59177e4f8ac66588911c31ba5bc65b50d42f9793721de88ea179059358ffe0ea.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, ‘CRAPS’ is written as PLXNZ,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eb4deb4b863ef8eb0ae82e5319cae7fef7ef3f3fbe6fb32a558395f7c14ad3a4.png] 

For, ‘DINED’ is written as AAKEA,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ce5bf554d1814691ead35a14e2b4f3ea79a306aebf33f552501d2d5f6843fec4.png] 

Similarly, for ‘INTRO’,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/548761515dcd526976ef918971174b55a041a1fb338ee76945134acc729768c3.png] 

So, ‘INTRO’ will be written as **LNQJF**.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
